reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited paragraphs support the conclusion: p0200 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's right to enter similar agreements with others, and p0190 (No Resale) restricts only resale of the Services, which is not an exclusive-dealing or all-requirements covenant on Customer.

Rationale correctly dismisses incidental uses of 'exclusive'/'sole' (warranty exclusivity, nonexclusive licence grants, tax-exclusive charges, 'sole discretion') as unrelated to exclusive dealing, consistent with the detection guidance.
Deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains; the clause set meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer).
